scan_description: Analyzes everything already sitting in Proxy History; no new requests are made.
empty_description_no_traffic: Proxy History is empty, capture some traffic first.
empty_description_no_findings: Nothing flagged across the scanned requests.
guide_intro: Unlike every other scanner here, this one makes zero requests: it reads what's already in Proxy History (from browsing through the proxy, from a Spider crawl, from Repeater sends) and flags patterns worth a second look. Click "Scan" any time new traffic comes in to re-check it.
guide_check_missing_headers: <0>Missing security headers</0>: CSP, HSTS (on HTTPS), X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options/frame-ancestors, Referrer-Policy. None of these alone is a vulnerability, but their absence removes a layer of defense.
guide_check_sensitive_data: <0>Sensitive data in the URL</0>: parameter names like <1>password</1>, <2>token</2>, <3>session</3> showing up in the query string, where they get logged and leaked via Referer.
guide_check_server_version: <0>Server version disclosure</0>: a <1>Server</1> or <2>X-Powered-By</2> header with a version number, handing an attacker exactly what to target.
guide_check_permissive_cors: <0>Permissive CORS</0>: a wildcard <1>Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *</1>, especially paired with <2>Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true</2>.
guide_check_credentials_http: <0>Credentials over plain HTTP</0>: a request that looks like it carries a password, sent unencrypted.
guide_icon_critical: <0>Critical</0>: a concrete, likely-exploitable issue (cleartext credentials, CORS that grants cross-origin credentialed access).
guide_icon_warning: <0>Warning</0>: a real weakness worth fixing, but not exploitable on its own (missing header, unflagged cookie, sensitive param in a URL).
guide_icon_info: <0>Info</0>: minor hardening or disclosure, low impact by itself.
guide_footer_note: Findings are grouped by host + issue, since the same missing header usually shows up on every page of a site; expand a card to see exactly which URLs it applies to.
